changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwclaimitem AS SELECT ci.id, ci.claim_request_id, ci.sequence, ci.patient_service_product_id, ci.financial_document_item_id, ci.billing_charge_line_id, ci.item_type, ci.item_code, ci.item_description, ci.invoice_no, ci.quantity, ci.unit_price, ci.net, ci.patient_share, ci.payer_share, ci.created_by, ci.created_date, ci.last_modified_by, ci.last_modified_date FROM public.claim_item ci;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwclaimitem TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwclaimitem FROM report_user;
